summary: Frontend-only mobile smoke test covered loading, sale CRUD entry, separate flock setup, production collection, productivity, and reload persistence. Expense creation failed to appear after save; report/buyer flow was blocked by that run's navigation state.

integration_issues.issue: Form closed after save but Keuangan showed 0 biaya and no Jagung record; expense was not persisted or rendered.

action_items: Reproduce expense creation with custom category and verify saveData/commit state update; then retest filters, report, and buyer management.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive controls do not expose testID attributes, making robust automated mobile testing difficult; accessibilityLabel is only used on some icon controls.
The live Expo log reports a React Native DevTools electron sandbox warning, though Metro/web bundling still succeeds.
seed_data_creation: Created local AsyncStorage test records for Bu Sari sale (4 eggs) and flock/production (10 chickens, 8 eggs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL tested at mobile 375x667. Sale total Rp 12.000, separate flock form, productivity 0.80, and reload persistence passed. Expense custom-category save did not render/persist. A first script had only a test-script syntax/strict-selector error, then the corrected run reproduced the expense issue.
rca_of_issue: Likely state/persistence or input mapping issue in FormSheet expense save path; after submit the modal closed but expenses remained empty. Inspect saveRecord/commit closure and confirm the filled cost/item values reach onSave. No APIs are mocked; app is intentionally offline-first.
